verses.original: וּבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן הוֹלִ֖יד אֶת־ בֶּ֣לַע בְּכֹר֑וֹ אַשְׁבֵּל֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְאַחְרַ֖ח הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇin·yā·min hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- be·la‘ bə·ḵō·rōw ’aš·bêl haš·šê·nî wə·’aḥ·raḥ haš·šə·lî·šî
verses.literal: Benjamin was the father of Bela his firstborn Ashbel the second Aharah the third
verses.literalPt: E BENJAMIM gerou a Belá, seu primogênito, a Asbel o segundo, e a Aará o terceiro,

verses.original: נוֹחָה֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י וְרָפָ֖א הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃ס
verses.literal: Nohah the fourth and Rapha the fifth
verses.literalPt: A Noá o quarto, e a Rafa o quinto.

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בָנִ֖ים לְבָ֑לַע אַדָּ֥ר וְגֵרָ֖א וַאֲבִיהֽוּד׃
verses.literal: The sons of Bela Addar Gera Abihud
verses.literalPt: E Belá teve estes filhos: Adar, Gera, Abiúde,

verses.original: וַאֲבִישׁ֥וּעַ וְנַעֲמָ֖ן וַאֲחֽוֹחַ׃
verses.literal: Abishua Naaman Ahoah
verses.literalPt: Abisua, Naamã, Aoá,

verses.original: וְגֵרָ֥א וּשְׁפוּפָ֖ן וְחוּרָֽם׃
verses.literal: Gera Shephuphan and Huram
verses.literalPt: Gera, Sefufá e Hurão.

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י אֵח֑וּד אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם רָאשֵׁ֤י אָבוֹת֙ לְי֣וֹשְׁבֵי גֶ֔בַע וַיַּגְל֖וּם אֶל־ מָנָֽחַת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh bə·nê ’ê·ḥūḏ ’êl·leh hêm rā·šê ’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·yō·wō·šə·ḇê ḡe·ḇa‘ way·yaḡ·lūm ’el- mā·nā·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: These were the descendants of Ehud . . . who were the heads of the families living in Geba and were exiled to Manahath
verses.literalPt: E estes foram os filhos de Eúde; que foram chefes dos pais dos moradores de Geba, e os levaram cativos a Manaate;

verses.original: וְנַעֲמָ֧ן וַאֲחִיָּ֛ה וְגֵרָ֖א ה֣וּא הֶגְלָ֑ם וְהוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ עֻזָּ֖א וְאֶת־ אֲחִיחֻֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·na·‘ă·mān wa·’ă·ḥî·yāh wə·ḡê·rā hū heḡ·lām wə·hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ‘uz·zā wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·ḥuḏ
verses.literal: Naaman Ahijah and Gera who carried them into exile and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud
verses.literalPt: E Naamã, e Aías e Gera; este os transportou, e gerou a Uzá e a Aiúde.

verses.original: וְשַׁחֲרַ֗יִם הוֹלִיד֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב מִן־ שִׁלְח֖וֹ אֹתָ֑ם חוּשִׁ֥ים וְאֶֽת־ בַּעֲרָ֖א נָשָֽׁיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ša·ḥă·ra·yim hō·w·lîḏ biś·ḏêh mō·w·’āḇ min- šil·ḥōw ’ō·ṯām ḥū·šîm wə·’eṯ- ba·‘ă·rā nā·šāw
verses.literal: Shaharaim had sons in the country of Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara
verses.literalPt: E Saaraim (depois de os enviar), na terra de Moabe, gerou filhos de Husim e Baara, suas mulheres.

verses.original: וַיּ֖וֹלֶד מִן־ חֹ֣דֶשׁ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ אֶת־ יוֹבָב֙ וְאֶת־ צִבְיָ֔א וְאֶת־ מֵישָׁ֖א וְאֶת־ מַלְכָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·leḏ min- ḥō·ḏeš ’iš·tōw ’eṯ- yō·w·ḇāḇ wə·’eṯ- ṣiḇ·yā wə·’eṯ- mê·šā wə·’eṯ- mal·kām
verses.literal: His sons by his wife Hodesh Jobab Zibia Mesha Malcam
verses.literalPt: E de Hodes, sua mulher, gerou a Jobabe, a Zibia, a Mesa, a Malcã,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ יְע֥וּץ וְאֶת־ שָֽׂכְיָ֖ה וְאֶת־ מִרְמָ֑ה אֵ֥לֶּה בָנָ֖יו רָאשֵׁ֥י אָבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- yə·‘ūṣ wə·’eṯ- śā·ḵə·yāh wə·’eṯ- mir·māh ’êl·leh ḇā·nāw rā·šê ’ā·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: Jeuz Sachia and Mirmah These were his sons heads of families
verses.literalPt: A Jeuz, a Saquias e a Mirma; estes foram seus filhos, chefes dos pais.

verses.original: וּמֵחֻשִׁ֛ים הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ אֲבִיט֖וּב וְאֶת־ אֶלְפָּֽעַל׃
verses.literal: He also had sons by Hushim Abitub and Elpaal
verses.literalPt: E de Husim gerou a Abitude e a Elpaal.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י אֶלְפַּ֔עַל עֵ֥בֶר וּמִשְׁעָ֖ם וָשָׁ֑מֶד ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת־ אוֹנ֔וֹ וְאֶת־ לֹ֖ד וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ’el·pa·‘al ‘ê·ḇer ū·miš·‘ām wā·šā·meḏ hū bā·nāh ’eṯ- ’ō·w·nōw wə·’eṯ- lōḏ ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: The sons of Elpaal Eber Misham Shemed who built Ono and Lod with its villages
verses.literalPt: E foram os filhos de Elpaal: Éber, Misã e Semede; este edificou a Ono e a Lode e os lugares da sua jurisdição.

verses.original: וּבְרִעָ֣ה וָשֶׁ֔מַע הֵ֚מָּה רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֔וֹת לְיוֹשְׁבֵ֖י אַיָּל֑וֹן הֵ֥מָּה הִבְרִ֖יחוּ אֶת־ י֥וֹשְׁבֵי גַֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ri·‘āh wā·še·ma‘ hêm·māh rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·yō·wō·šə·ḇê ’ay·yā·lō·wn hêm·māh hiḇ·rî·ḥū ’eṯ- yō·wō·šə·ḇê ḡaṯ
verses.literal: and Beriah and Shema who were the heads of families living in Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath
verses.literalPt: E Berias e Sema foram cabeças dos pais dos moradores de Aijalom; estes afugentaram os moradores de Gate.

verses.original: וְאַחְי֥וֹ שָׁשָׁ֖ק וִירֵמֽוֹת׃
verses.literal: Ahio Shashak Jeremoth
verses.literalPt: E Aiô, Sasaque, Jerimote,

verses.original: וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה וַעֲרָ֖ד וָעָֽדֶר׃
verses.literal: Zebadiah Arad Eder
verses.literalPt: Zebadias, Arade, Eder,

verses.original: וּמִיכָאֵ֧ל וְיִשְׁפָּ֛ה וְיוֹחָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י בְרִיעָֽה׃
verses.literal: Michael Ishpah and Joha were the sons of Beriah
verses.literalPt: Micael, Ispa e Joa foram filhos de Berias.

verses.original: וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה וּמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם וְחִזְקִ֥י וָחָֽבֶר׃
verses.literal: Zebadiah Meshullam Hizki Heber
verses.literalPt: Zebadias, Mesulão, Hizque, Héber,

verses.original: וְיִשְׁמְרַ֧י וְיִזְלִיאָ֛ה וְיוֹבָ֖ב בְּנֵ֥י אֶלְפָּֽעַל׃
verses.literal: Ishmerai Izliah and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal
verses.literalPt: Ismerai, Izlias e Jobabe, filhos de Elpaal.

verses.original: וְיָקִ֥ים וְזִכְרִ֖י וְזַבְדִּֽי׃
verses.literal: Jakim Zichri Zabdi
verses.literalPt: Jaquim, Zicri, Zabdi,

verses.original: וֶאֱלִיעֵנַ֥י וְצִלְּתַ֖י וֶאֱלִיאֵֽל׃
verses.literal: Elienai Zillethai Eliel
verses.literalPt: Elienai, Ziletai, Eliel,

verses.original: וַעֲדָיָ֧ה וּבְרָאיָ֛ה וְשִׁמְרָ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י שִׁמְעִֽי׃
verses.literal: Adaiah Beraiah and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei
verses.literalPt: Adaías, Beraías e Sinrate, filhos de Simei.

verses.original: וְיִשְׁפָּ֥ן וָעֵ֖בֶר וֶאֱלִיאֵֽל׃
verses.literal: Ishpan Eber Eliel
verses.literalPt: E Ispã, Éber, Eliel,

verses.original: וְעַבְדּ֥וֹן וְזִכְרִ֖י וְחָנָֽן׃
verses.literal: Abdon Zichri Hanan
verses.literalPt: Abdom, Zicri, Hanã,

verses.original: וַחֲנַנְיָ֥ה וְעֵילָ֖ם וְעַנְתֹתִיָּֽה׃
verses.literal: Hananiah Elam Anthothijah
verses.literalPt: Hananias, Elão, Antotias,

verses.original: וְיִפְדְיָ֥ה וּפְנִיאֵל בְּנֵ֥י שָׁשָֽׁק׃
verses.literal: Iphdeiah and Penuel were the sons of Shashak
verses.literalPt: E Ifdéias, e Penuel, filhos de Sasaque;

verses.original: וְשַׁמְשְׁרַ֥י וּשְׁחַרְיָ֖ה וַעֲתַלְיָֽה׃
verses.literal: Shamsherai Shehariah Athaliah
verses.literalPt: E Sanserai, e Searias, e Atalias,

verses.original: וְיַעֲרֶשְׁיָ֧ה וְאֵלִיָּ֛ה וְזִכְרִ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יְרֹחָֽם׃
verses.literal: Jaareshiah Elijah and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham
verses.literalPt: E Jaaresias, e Elias e Zicri, filhos de Jeroão.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֛וֹת לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
verses.literal: All these were heads of families the chiefs . . . according to their genealogies and they lived in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Estes foram cabeças dos pais, segundo as suas gerações, chefes, e habitaram em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וּבְגִבְע֥וֹן יָשְׁב֖וּ אֲבִ֣י גִבְע֑וֹן וְשֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מַעֲכָֽה׃
verses.literal: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon His wife’s name was Maacah
verses.literalPt: E em Gibeão habitou o pai de Gibeão; e era o nome de sua mulher Maaca;

verses.original: וּבְנ֥וֹ הַבְּכ֖וֹר עַבְדּ֑וֹן וְצ֥וּר וְקִ֖ישׁ וּבַ֥עַל וְנָדָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nōw hab·bə·ḵō·wr ‘aḇ·dō·wn wə·ṣūr wə·qîš ū·ḇa·‘al wə·nā·ḏāḇ
verses.literal: and Abdon was his firstborn son then Zur Kish Baal Nadab
verses.literalPt: E seu filho primogênito, Abdom; depois Zur, e Quis, Baal, e Nadabe,

verses.original: וּגְד֥וֹר וְאַחְי֖וֹ וָזָֽכֶר׃
verses.literal: Gedor Ahio Zecher
verses.literalPt: E Gedor, Aiô, e Zequer,

verses.original: וּמִקְל֖וֹת הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ שִׁמְאָ֑ה וְאַף־ הֵ֗מָּה נֶ֧גֶד אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עִם־ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·miq·lō·wṯ hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- šim·’āh wə·’ap̄- hêm·māh ne·ḡeḏ ’ă·ḥê·hem yā·šə·ḇū ḇî·rū·šā·lim ‘im- ’ă·ḥê·hem
verses.literal: and Mikloth who was the father of Shimeah They too lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E Miclote gerou a Siméia; e também estes, defronte de seus irmãos, habitaram em Jerusalém com eles.

verses.original: וְנֵר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ קִ֔ישׁ וְקִ֖ישׁ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ שָׁא֑וּל וְשָׁא֗וּל הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת־ יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ וְאֶת־ מַלְכִּי־ שׁ֔וּעַ וְאֶת־ אֲבִֽינָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־ אֶשְׁבָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nêr hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- qîš wə·qîš hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- šā·’ūl wə·šā·’ūl hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān wə·’eṯ- mal·kî- šū·a‘ wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·nā·ḏāḇ wə·’eṯ- ’eš·bā·‘al
verses.literal: Ner was the father of Kish Kish was the father of Saul and Saul was the father of Jonathan Malchishua Abinadab and Esh-baal
verses.literalPt: E Ner gerou a Quis, e Quis gerou a Saul; e Saul gerou a Jônatas, a Malquisua, a Abinadabe, e a Esbaal.

verses.original: וּבֶן־ יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן מְרִ֣יב בָּ֑עַל וּמְרִ֥יב בַּ֖עַל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ מִיכָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇen- yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān mə·rîḇ bā·‘al ū·mə·rîḇ ba·‘al hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- mî·ḵāh
verses.literal: The son of Jonathan Merib-baal and Merib-baal was the father of Micah
verses.literalPt: E filho de Jônatas foi Meribe-Baal; e Meribe-Baal gerou a Mica.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י מִיכָ֑ה פִּית֥וֹן וָמֶ֖לֶךְ וְתַאְרֵ֥עַ וְאָחָֽז׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê mî·ḵāh pî·ṯō·wn wā·me·leḵ wə·ṯa’·rê·a‘ wə·’ā·ḥāz
verses.literal: The sons of Micah Pithon Melech Tarea and Ahaz
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Mica foram: Pitom, Meleque, Tareá, e Acaz.

verses.original: וְאָחָז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יְהוֹעַדָּ֔ה וִיהֽוֹעַדָּ֗ה הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת־ עָלֶ֥מֶת וְאֶת־ עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־ זִמְרִ֑י וְזִמְרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ מוֹצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḥāz hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- yə·hō·w·‘ad·dāh wî·hō·w·‘ad·dāh hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ‘ā·le·meṯ wə·’eṯ- ‘az·mā·weṯ wə·’eṯ- zim·rî wə·zim·rî hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- mō·w·ṣā
verses.literal: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth Azmaveth and Zimri and Zimri was the father of Moza
verses.literalPt: E Acaz gerou a Jeoada; e Jeoada gerou a Alemete, e a Azmavete, e a Zinri; e Zinri gerou a Moza,

verses.original: וּמוֹצָ֖א הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ בִּנְעָ֑א רָפָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·w·ṣā hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- bin·‘ā rā·p̄āh ḇə·nōw ’el·‘ā·śāh ḇə·nōw ’ā·ṣêl bə·nōw
verses.literal: Moza was the father of Binea Raphah was his son Eleasah his son and Azel his son
verses.literalPt: E Moza gerou a Bineá, cujo filho foi Rafa, de quem foi filho Eleazá, cujo filho foi Azel.

verses.original: וּלְאָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם׀ בֹּ֙כְרוּ֙ וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּשְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְעֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְחָנָ֑ן כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·’ā·ṣêl šiš·šāh ḇā·nîm wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·w·ṯām ‘az·rî·qām bō·ḵə·rū wə·yiš·mā·‘êl ū·šə·‘ar·yāh wə·‘ō·ḇaḏ·yāh wə·ḥā·nān kāl- ’êl·leh bə·nê ’ā·ṣal
verses.literal: Azel had six sons and these were their names Azrikam Bocheru Ishmael Sheariah Obadiah and Hanan All these were the sons of Azel
verses.literalPt: E teve Azel seis filhos, e estes foram os seus nomes: Azricão, Bocru, Ismael, Searias, Obadias, e Hanã; todos estes foram filhos de Azel.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י עֵ֣שֶׁק אָחִ֑יו אוּלָ֣ם בְּכֹר֔וֹ יְעוּשׁ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וֶֽאֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ‘ê·šeq ’ā·ḥîw ’ū·lām bə·ḵō·rōw yə·‘ūš haš·šê·nî we·’ĕ·lî·p̄e·leṭ haš·šə·li·šî
verses.literal: The sons of his brother Eshek Ulam was his firstborn Jeush second and Eliphelet third
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Ezeque, seu irmão: Ulão, seu primogênito, Jeús o segundo e Elifelete o terceiro.

verses.original: וַֽיִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי־ א֠וּלָם אֲנָשִׁ֨ים גִּבֹּרֵי־ חַ֜יִל דֹּ֣רְכֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת וּמַרְבִּ֤ים בָּנִים֙ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים מֵאָ֖ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֑ים כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה מִבְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū ḇə·nê- ’ū·lām ’ă·nā·šîm gib·bō·rê- ḥa·yil dō·rə·ḵê qe·šeṯ ū·mar·bîm bā·nîm ū·ḇə·nê ḇā·nîm mê·’āh wa·ḥă·miš·šîm kāl- ’êl·leh mib·bə·nê ḇin·yā·min
verses.literal: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor archers . . . and they had many sons and grandsons . . . 150 in all . . . All these were the descendants of Benjamin
verses.literalPt: E foram os filhos de Ulão homens heróis, valentes, e flecheiros destros; e tiveram muitos filhos, e filhos de filhos, cento e cinqüenta; todos estes foram dos filhos de Benjamim.
